'''Celestial Serenity''' was an enhanced [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who played against [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. The first time she played him she lost, and the second time she nearly took all of his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
